entries.subject: tenant-switch
entries.reason: in-package tenant switch needs a signed-in session: no deployment credentials in this environment (WEKNORA_MOBILE_TEST_* unset) and idb tap/input automation is unavailable, so the login form cannot be filled; the runtime-integration-smoke tenant path also skips without credentials

entries.subject: task
entries.reason: opt-in live task creation through task-start-integration-smoke skipped: deployment credentials unset in this environment (4/12 live tests in the re-run skipped, skip is not a pass); the structural opt-in/total tests (8/12) are unit-level and do not count as integration evidence

entries.subject: background-recovery
entries.reason: cold-boot restore across runtime instances needs a real deployment (WEKNORA_MOBILE_TEST_* unset); the fake-server regression in ios-core-workflow-integration-smoke.test.ts exercises the real runtime/task-office/transport code paths but against a stubbed server, which AC3 does not allow to impersonate real integration evidence

entries.subject: offline-draft
entries.reason: offline-vault-integration-smoke live path skipped: deployment credentials unset in this environment; the in-package offline draft path additionally needs a signed-in session to produce a draft

entries.subject: notification
entries.reason: downgraded from the planned evidenced classification by the live run: the system rejected the local push to the unauthorized package (UNErrorDomain 2003 'Source is not authorized', archived at ios-evidence/t39/push-error.txt) — delivery to the app could not be proven, so 'notification arrived' is not claimable; APNs remote push needs credentials that do not exist here; fail-closed survival after the attempt is evidenced by ios-evidence/t39/06-push-unauthorized-fail-closed.png + push-process-alive.txt but is not notification-flow evidence

entries.subject: download-share
entries.reason: system share sheet is a true external (spec: real-device acceptance separately); the material harness live path also needs deployment credentials that are unset here

entries.subject: secure-storage
entries.reason: Keychain-backed secure storage acceptance needs a signed-in package writing credentials and a relaunch restoring them; without deployment credentials nothing is ever stored; the harness equivalent (file-backed cross-instance restore) needs a real deployment for the authorized surface

entries.subject: weak-network
entries.reason: host-level dummynet weak network requires sudo pf changes (host state change, needs explicit human approval per plan constraint); the transport-injection weak-network path in ios-core-workflow-integration-smoke needs a real deployment (credentials unset); the fake-server dead-wiring regression proves the injection wiring reconciles to one run (distinctRunIds=1, startRequests=1) but against a stubbed server, which AC3 does not allow to impersonate real integration evidence
